title: Electric Serpent in Orb
description: A vibrant purple and cyan scaled serpent with glowing red eyes is coiled inside a large translucent sphere, its mouth open as it emits bright blue and pink lightning bolts. A dark, gnarled leafless tree with twisted branches occupies the foreground, set against a swirling dark purple and black background filled with ethereal mist.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a large iridescent purple and cyan scaled serpent with glowing red eyes coiled inside a massive translucent glowing sphere. The serpent's mouth is open, releasing bright pink and blue lightning bolts that crackle around it. In the foreground, a dark twisted leafless tree with intricate branches reaches toward the orb. The entire scene is set against a deep black and swirling purple smoky background, highly detailed digital painting with vibrant neon accents.
